segments.he:
תּוֹרָה נח
כָּל מַה שֶּׁהַצַּדִּיק גָּדוֹל בְּמַעֲלָה יוֹתֵר, וְהוּא בְּתַכְלִית הָעֲנָוָה בְּחִינַת אַיִן בֶּאֱמֶת, הוּא יָכוֹל לְהַשְׁגִּיחַ וּלְהִסְתַּכֵּל יוֹתֵר עַל הָעוֹלָם, וְלֹא כְּמוֹ שֶׁטּוֹעִין קְצָת בְּנֵי אָדָם שֶׁאוֹמְרִים שֶׁמֵּחֲמַת גְּדֻלַּת הַצַּדִּיק הוּא רָחוֹק מֵהָעוֹלָם (עַיֵּן פְּנִים):
segments.en:
Opening of Part Two (Tinyana): A new section of the Kitzur — reflecting the second part of Likutay Moharan — the green header colour distinguishes this section visually throughout.

Hashmatah (Omitted Teaching): The foundational stance — "Avraham was one." To enter the service of Hashem one must think of oneself as entirely alone — paying no attention to any person who prevents.

T1 (20 sections): The vast opening Toirah — the Jewish person's destiny to have dominion over the angels. Three desires (money, immorality, food) destroy heart-fear. Honouring the three festivals rectifies each desire in turn. The full chain: fear → prophetic influence → perfect prayer → healing without medicines. Rosh Hashonah's kindness. The shofar sounds as the vessel for all these rectifications.

T2 (14 sections): Chanukah as the World to Come's delight — hallel, thanksgiving, and halachah study. Four aspects of speech. Truth completes them. Shabbos blessing drawn into the weekdays. Segulah for difficult labour: Mizmor L'Sodah.

T4 (12 sections): The great Toirah on charity — breaking natural cruelty to give. Charity as birth-labour. Charity widens all openings of holiness. The wisdom-of-nature philosophers as predatory beasts. Charity nullifies their power and releases captured souls.

T5 (18 sections): Faith is the foundation — without it, medicines, prayer, and ancestral merit all fail. The glimmering of Mashiach in every Jew. The shield of the earth against immoral thoughts transforms them into tefillin-minds. Rosh Hashonah gathers the fragments of faith.

T7 (14 sections): The true leader must be compassionate — and compassion means giving da'as to draw Israel from sin. The obligation of every Jew to illuminate da'as in their fellow. Surrounding lights — the World to Come. The leader who teaches dwellers above and below. The sage's hints draw livelihood. Rosh Hashonah rectifies all five senses.

T8 (12 sections): Only one worthy to rebuke can add a good scent to souls. The song to be awakened in the future. The importance of drawing close to a true leader to attain complete faith — faith in creation ex nihilo.

T10 (6 sections): The famous teaching — rejoice because Hashem has not made you a non-Jew. This joy has no confusion — it is entirely G-d's act. Use words of foolishness to reach joy. Sadness is the sitra achra and is forbidden.

T12 §2: One of the most striking teachings — even when fallen to the most disgraceful places — search and cry: "Where is the place of His glory?" The very crying out lifts one to the highest ascent — the aspect of Ayyeh.

T19: Powerful warning against philosophical inquiry — books of inquiry are strictly forbidden. Only the very great Tzadik can enter the seven wisdoms and remain standing through faith.

T24: Joy is a great commandment equal and opposite to sadness being a great sin. Designate one hour for a broken heart — the rest of the day — joy.

T25 §1: Hisbodidus — the supreme practice — in one's own spoken language — encompasses all service and is how all the great Tzadikim reached their level.

T48 §§1–7: The great encouragement — do not fall because you seem still far. Every tiny movement away from materiality toward G-d covers thousands of leagues in the upper worlds. The narrow bridge. Dances and leaps to reach joy. The tree that shoots after a hundred years.

Translation in the merit of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman  ·  May Hashem bless all who learn from it.

  נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן
